title: THE WHEEL GROWS WITH THE SCREEN
why: Seen on the 4K picture of the item wheel (his bar for looks): the wheel and the plate that shows the item in hand kept their 1080p size on a 4K screen, so the wheel was small and sat on top of the belt. They now grow with the screen the way the belt and the backpack do (hudRes), the wheel is a little smaller at 1080p so it never reaches down into the belt, and the hub in the middle is see-through so your character stays visible while you choose.
now: The item wheel and the item plate now grow with the screen, stay clear of the belt, and the hub shows your character.
